command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/mail-filter-routing
./bin/deliver < samples/accounts.eml
./bin/deliver < samples/accounts.eml
./bin/deliver < samples/support.eml
./bin/deliver < samples/general.eml
printf '%s\n' '--- delivered files ---'
find Maildir -path '*/new/*' -type f -printf '%P %s bytes\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- delivery hashes ---'
find Maildir -path '*/new/*' -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- route/count/byte checks ---'
check_delivery() {
    department=$1
    sample=$2
    expected=$3
    sample_hash=$(sha256sum "$sample" | awk '{print $1}')
    count=0
    for delivered in Maildir/$department/new/*; do
        [ -f "$delivered" ] || continue
        delivered_hash=$(sha256sum "$delivered" | awk '{print $1}')
        if [ "$delivered_hash" = "$sample_hash" ]; then
            cmp -s "$sample" "$delivered"
            count=$((count + 1))
        fi
    done
    [ "$count" -eq "$expected" ]
    printf '%s sample=%s exact_copies=%s expected=%s PASS\n' "$department" "$sample_hash" "$count" "$expected"
}
check_delivery accounts samples/accounts.eml 2
check_delivery support samples/support.eml 1
check_delivery general samples/general.eml 1
[ "$(find Maildir/accounts/new -type f | wc -l)" -eq 2 ]
[ "$(find Maildir/support/new -type f | wc -l)" -eq 1 ]
[ "$(find Maildir/general/new -type f | wc -l)" -eq 1 ]
printf '%s\n' 'routing, distinct delivery, and byte preservation: PASS'

done
